name: my-task-manager-server
description: A simple task manager that helps users organize and track everyday tasks.

interface.longDescription: Efficient Task Manager helps users organize and track everyday tasks through ChatGPT. It provides a simple way to keep track of what needs to get done.

positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_lessons with no query and lists every lesson: upcoming ones first with dates and signup links, then recordings.

positive.prompt: I want API Lessons for Product Managers
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_lessons with a query such as "product manager" and returns API product management lessons, such as "The Double Life of the API Product Manager" and "How to break into API Product Management", with their courses.

positive.description: Find upcoming live training on a topic
positive.prompt: I'm searching for live training on MCP
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_lessons with status Scheduled and query "MCP" and returns upcoming MCP lessons with their dates and signup links.

positive.description: Find a recording on a topic
positive.prompt: Is there a recording about agentic payments?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_lessons with status On Demand and query "payments" and returns "Agentic Payments: How AI Agents Move Money" and "Building APIs That Move Money" with their recording links.

positive.description: Find the course that goes deeper
positive.prompt: I watched the MCP product manager lesson. Which course goes deeper?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_lessons with a query such as "MCP product manager", finds "Become an MCP Product Manager & Build Agent Experiences" and names its course, "Build What Agents Want: MCP, APIs, Skills & Plugins", with its link.
